interpretation_boundary: F controls pixel features entering Fusion directly, but can still alter fused support and downstream morphology/gates. S controls only the explicit pixel-support term. Frozen-model inference intervention only.

required_answers.1_F0S1_strict_pixel_support: PASS: 600/600 diagnostic steps retained nonzero support recomputed from the current raw Pixel Encoder output; raw and explicit support means matched exactly.
required_answers.2_F1S0_strict_pixel_feature: PASS: 600/600 diagnostic steps retained nonzero raw Pixel Encoder features in the Fusion input while the explicit support term was exactly zero.
required_answers.3_F1S1_full_regression: PASS: Bank A/B/C fixed-slot PNG SHA256 all matched historical Full.
required_answers.4_F0S0_latent_regression: PASS: Bank A/B/C fixed-slot PNG SHA256 all matched Experiment 14 LatentOnly.
required_answers.5_F0S1_change: Versus F0S0 on B+C Black: KID -0.0061262052 and FID -10.532895 (better both). Versus Full: KID -0.0003831905, FID +0.964095 (mixed).
required_answers.6_F1S0_change: Versus F0S0 on B+C Black: KID -0.0030912577 and FID -2.540295 (better both). Versus Full: KID +0.0026517570 and FID +8.956695 (worse both).
required_answers.7_conditional_complementarity: Descriptive non-additivity is positive (KID 0.0034744482; FID 1.576200), but conditional Pixel Feature effects are not directionally stable; there is no robust complementarity claim.
required_answers.8_larger_aligned_support_effect: Explicit Pixel Support (S). Removing S reduced mean aligned-support area from 0.0008544922 to 0.0004882812; removing F with S retained caused no mean area change.
required_answers.9_larger_residual_effect: Explicit Pixel Support (S). Full-to-F1S0 mean residual-L2 change was 2.84181468 versus 0.39959231 for Full-to-F0S1.
required_answers.10_support_shrinkage: Yes, S-off systematically reduced aligned-support area by 42.86% and final-support area by 41.94%; no step crossed the fixed abnormal-small threshold.
required_answers.11_full_best: Full remains the strongest balanced MSDF configuration, but is not the unanimous metric winner: F0S1 has slightly lower B+C Black KID while Full has lower FID.
required_answers.12_raw_gap: Mixed. F0S1 narrows the Black KID gap to Raw by 0.0003831905 versus Full, but widens the FID gap by 0.964095; it still trails Raw by 38.94% KID and 12.61% FID.
required_answers.13_new_fusion_basis: Insufficient evidence for a new Fusion architecture: direct Pixel Feature effects are small/mixed, while the explicit support path explains the larger support/residual change.
required_answers.14_next_single_mechanism: Study the explicit Pixel Support composition/alignment mechanism, especially how fused support and pixel support are combined before morphology; do not expand this experiment automatically.
